subject.title: feat: expose resolved backend model in session_status and agent runtime

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class resolved backend model/provider/fallback fields to session metadata and `session_status`, and what source is authoritative when provider responses, fallback traces, and user-selected aliases disagree?
rationale: This changes stable session/status and provider-routing contracts, so automation should not choose the long-term data model or public field names without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add additive resolved fields
options.body: Introduce separate requested and resolved identity fields backed by provider response/fallback trace data, with focused tests and docs for status/runtime consumers.

options.title: Limit to status display
options.body: Fix the misleading `session_status`/CLI card first while deferring durable session-row/API fields to a later contract discussion.

options.title: Defer to provider-specific telemetry
options.body: Keep OpenClaw core unchanged and leave proxy-specific resolved-model details to external logs or provider integrations.

recommendation.title: Add additive resolved fields
recommendation.body: Introduce separate requested and resolved identity fields backed by provider response/fallback trace data, with focused tests and docs for status/runtime consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: The current session/status/provider-routing code history in this checkout points to Vincent Koc as the best available routing candidate.
